LanguageData.RKU_Allurecap.label: Allurecap
LanguageData.RKU_Hatecap.label: Hatecap
LanguageData.RKU_Hatecap.description: The Hatecap, though foul-smelling, is often accompanied by beneficial fungal clusters in its vicinity.
LanguageData.RKU_Mindspark.label: Inspirationcap
LanguageData.RKU_Mindspark.description: The Inspirationcap, it grants inspiration corresponding to the highest-level skill when consumed. Once harvested, it will rapidly dissolves into a black liquid and must be eaten immediately on the spot.
LanguageData.RKU_Singularitycap.label: Antigraincap
LanguageData.RKU_Singularitycap.description: The Antigraincap, whose spores are said to have served as raw material for ancient weapons, yet become partially deactivated when exposed to light.
